mentions.name: Climbing Gym Photogrammetry
mentions.description: This project reconstructs a 3D model of a climbing gym from regular phone video so that route and climb recordings can be reviewed against the 3D gym model instead of a flat video. It captures body positions across time (4D video) to help climbers review and improve their climbing, producing reasonable results from a single video without requiring multiple camera angles. Monetization is not yet decided.
mentions.problem: Climb recordings are normally reviewed as flat plan video, but effective climbing improvement requires reviewing body positions over time, which has typically needed multiple camera angles.
mentions.audience: Climbers who want to review their own climbs, alone and with other people, to improve
mentions.source_excerpt: Climbing gym photogrammetry. My idea is that route and climb recordings is best recorded against a 3D climbing gym model, rather than a plan video, and technology has gotten good enough to do with a regular phone.
